target_customer: Behavioral health providers and operators who need structured patient records and compliance documentation
problem: Behavioral health records are fragmented across sources, so clinicians and AI systems lack a single accurate patient picture.
business_model: B2B SaaS for behavioral health organizations (pricing not found)
product_category: Healthcare records structuring and compliance AI

founders.name: Angie Muller
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as Founder/CEO; other sources spell the name Angelia Muller. No background on the page.

founders.name: Briar Smith
founders.background_notes: Named as second founder in the YC launch post; title not given there. Crunchbase calls him CTO, unconfirmed elsewhere.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting and reconciling messy clinical records with LLMs under privacy rules is standard AI engineering with hard integration and accuracy work.

defensibility.rationale: Record ingestion and compliance workflows could create integration lock-in, but the underlying models are widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI documentation vendors expanded in behavioral health, but no source shows any copying Attunement's records-structuring wedge.

market_need_then: Behavioral health providers face documentation and audit burden; Attunement's own YC job post claims clinics cut audit prep time by 80%, a company claim not independently verified.

branding.domain_note: Redirects attunement.ai to attunementclinical.com (301 redirect observed); how the domains were obtained not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Common word shared with other YC and health companies (for example Attuned Intelligence is unrelated), and no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Patient monitoring and treatment recommendation platform for behavioral health
pivots.to: Compliance and records infrastructure for AI in behavioral health, then clinical records structuring
pivots.why: Not stated; directories note the product was rebuilt at least twice since the January 2024 YC launch

outcome_analysis: Attunement is listed active with a team of three and has repositioned from patient monitoring toward records structuring and compliance infrastructure. No funding beyond a reported YC convertible note was found and no exit or shutdown news exists, so the outcome is unknown rather than a clear success or failure; the repeated pivots suggest a search for a sharper wedge.
notes: CB Insights alone reports a $500K convertible note from Y Combinator dated January 2024; Seedtable shows none. Unverified, not recorded as a round. Competitor searches returned only 2025 to 2026 vendor material, so the list is empty. Founding year: YC says 2024, CB Insights 2023. Company site attunement.ai redirects to attunementclinical.com, which was not fetched.
